title: Hotline home.rollback
description: Make an earlier home page curation live again (Bureau §6.4, ADR 0005): `POST /v1/home/curation/rollback` on the write API, then the local record. The version must be one this laptop published; naming the live version changes nothing. Board's published-content action; the command has no CLI form. Input is the request's args; output is the reply envelope's data.

version.description: The curation version to make live
The newest curation version the API holds

live_version.description: The version that is live now
